scope: Bounded authoring checks and one actual current-incident three-agent demonstration, not a discovery recall benchmark.

baseline.method: Separate Copilot subagent explicitly emulating the old deterministic four-feed/tier-and-lesson-count policy on six synthetic scenarios.
baseline.limitations: The baseline was prompted policy emulation, not an uncontrolled behavioral experiment or a live full-web search.
observations: An official Notion-like advisory absent from the finite feeds was missed.
Eight generic bullets could outrank three substantive lessons within the same explanation tier.
A major provider status was selected without establishing its cause.
The old policy had no event-level cross-outlet alias review or chronology reconciliation.

with_skill.method: Fresh-context Copilot subagent read the skill and applied it to the same synthetic scenarios without network access or file edits.
checks: Explicitly searches official advisory and AI infrastructure sources beyond feeds.
Reconciles later scope updates without rewriting early dataset-specific evidence.
Merges verified syndicated aliases, not separate intrusions at the same vendor.
Keeps Notion-like entry vector unknown; treats key rotation as containment, not cause.
Does not reward generic bullet count.

fixture_results.scenario: Viral headline with eight generic bullets

with_skill.limitations: Synthetic instruction-compliance check. These fixture scores are not published incident judgments or proof of exhaustive discovery.

plugin.format: Official legacy Copilot plugin.json with mapped agents and skills paths; no Agent Plugins 1.0 schema mixed in.
plugin.install_state: Ephemeral local package load verified. No global installation claimed.

checks: no-JavaScript Latest and native expandable details

resolved: Complete bounded article hashes include corrections beyond 24,000 characters
Failed or expired provider observations remove trusted scores
Per-URL reviews cannot rebaseline unrelated changed sources
code_review.regressions: Three focused regression tests failed before their fixes and passed afterward.

release_validation.scope: Local release evidence. Actual deployment is independently recorded in GitHub Actions history.

actual_three_agent_demonstration.execution: Three sequential real Copilot general-purpose subagents explicitly loaded each new role instruction file and skill. The host could not dynamically register those new custom-role names in its task tool. This is not a claim of installed-registry role selection.

agents.result: Read two primary public bodies, found no archive duplicate, preserved separate Fireworks intrusions.
Read the two primary bodies and reconciled Notion scope chronology against Fireworks November 17 update; no unsupported intrusion mapping.
Read the dossier, wrote an original report and seven-step sourced diagram, proposed dimensions 4/3/4/3 (87/100), then revised for compact formal publication. No browsing or publication.

actual_three_agent_demonstration.parent_review: GPT-6.1 Sol integrated the writer handoff, checked attribution/unknowns and sealed actual source-body and raw-record hashes. Subagent model IDs were not exposed and are not invented.
actual_three_agent_demonstration.remaining_limits: One bounded demonstrated event, not an autonomous recurring news service. Daily Actions does not run Copilot agents.
